summary: Granite Construction closed a private offering of $600M 6.375% senior notes due 2034, generating ~$590M net proceeds. The proceeds, plus cash on hand and capped call payments, will redeem all outstanding 3.75% convertible notes due 2028, repay credit facility borrowings, and for general corporate purposes. The notes are senior unsecured and guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries that are borrowers under the credit facility. The filing primarily describes a refinancing and debt restructuring rather than a pure capital return, but the redemption of convertible notes with cash qualifies as a capital return to prior noteholders. Watch for interest rate environment shifts and credit rating impact.
